title: 3do.com, from three divisions to a list of games
lede: Screenshots of pages saved by the Internet Archive’s Wayback Machine, stored as images. Click one to open the original capture. A capture from May 2000, the peak year, had lost nearly all its images and is not shown.[^42]

snips.text: Three sections: **The Company**, **Studio 3DO** and **3DO Systems**, the last offering “3DO MPEGXpress”, “M2 Technology” and “PC Technology”.
Upcoming games: “Jacked”, “Street Racing Syndicate” and two Army Men titles for the GameCube. New releases: “High Heat Major League Baseball 2004” and “Army Men: RTS”.

note: Several images in the 2003 page were never archived and show as empty boxes.

captures.label: Three divisions
captures.title: After the about-face
captures.text: Three months after 3DO said it would become a software company[^25], the home page still gives equal space to 3DO Systems, the hardware group Samsung would buy the following June.[^3] The online game Meridian 59 gets the top link.

captures.label: We’re Here to Play
captures.title: Eight weeks before Chapter 11
captures.text: The page lists Street Racing Syndicate and Jacked as coming soon. Neither had been released when the assets were auctioned in August; they went to Namco and JoWooD.[^16][^30][^31]
captures.warn: Some images in this capture were not archived.
